subject: Early-adopter credit & SLA for Private Deployment
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medtech.io>

Cc: procurement@medtech.io
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Early-adopter credit & SLA for Private Deployment

Hi Soojin / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about the private VPC deployment option. Before we engage procurement, two quick asks so we can scope an internal buy decision: 

1) Can Redwood offer an "early-adopter" credit against the platform fee for Year 1? We are evaluating a 12-month pilot but have constrained budget in Q4.
2) We need clarity on SLA tiers and associated credits. Our security folks want a clear failure-to-SLA credit schedule and an option for a 24x7 on-call premium.

If you can sketch a few commercial options (amortization of platform fee over 12 vs 24 months, sample support pricing, and any migration/training credits), I can share with procurement and legal.

Attaching a short procurement checklist we use frequently (procurement@medtech.io copied).

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform Engineering
MedTech Solutions

--

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medtech.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Early-adopter credit & SLA for Private Deployment

Hi Elena — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks. High level options below; happy to turn any of these into a short SOW and pricing table.

Option A (Pilot / 12mo) — conservative up-front:
- Platform fee: $120k/year (covers control plane + air-gap packaging).
- Early-adopter credit: 25% credit applied to platform fee in Year 1 if contract signed by 2025-10-31 (effective discount = $30k).
- Amortization: full platform fee invoiced monthly; we can present accounting language to amortize internally over 12 months if helpful.
- Support: Standard (business hours, 8x5) included. Premium 24x7 on-call: +$6k/month.
- Migration/training credit: 100 hours engineering credit (applies to professional services effort) included.

Option B (Committed / 24mo) — predictable economics:
- Platform fee: $110k/year with 24-month commitment.
- Early-adopter credit: 15% credit Year 1 (since larger time commitment).
- Amortization: option to invoice 50% on signature, remainder monthly; we can map to your capital/opex preference.
- Support: Premium included for first 3 months; after that, +$4k/month.
- Migration/training credit: 200 hours.

SLA & failure credits (summary):
- Latency/availability SLO: target 99.9% monthly for private deployments.
- Credit trigger: below 99.9% -> pro-rata service credit up to 10% of that month's platform fee; below 99.0% -> up to 25% credit.
- On-call response SLAs differ by support tier (Standard: next-business-day acknowledgement; Premium: 1 hour acknowledgement + escalation path).

Notes: 
- Credits expire if not used within 6 months of onboarding; migration credits applied against billable PS hours.
- We can carve out a limited RPO/RTO addendum for regulated workloads (adds to SOW).

I'll attach a draft SOW and a pricing CSV for quick review. If these high-level numbers are directionally OK, I'll loop in Legal to prepare a short pilot SOW and bring David (our finance lead) into scope for invoicing terms.

Would you be available for a 30-min call Thursday morning to go through trade-offs?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-vpc-pricing-sheet.csv (stub); MedTech-SOW-draft.pdf (stub)

Thanks Soojin — this is really helpful. A few follow-ups from procurement and security: 

- Procurement: can the early-adopter credit be reflected as a line-item credit on invoices rather than an abstract amortization? Their preference is visible discounts on invoice history.
- Security: can you confirm whether platform fee includes encryption key management integrations (we use AWS KMS + internal HSM) or whether that's an add-on? Also need confirmation of retention of audit logs (minimum 12 months).

Also attaching our standard SOC + security questionnaire; legal will want the SOW + redlines before signature. Procurement asked whether credits expire if MedTech converts pilot to full paid deployment earlier than 12 months.

If you can give short answers to the above and send a SOW that shows invoice-credit language and a KMS/integrations clause, procurement can move faster.

Best,
Elena

Elena — quick clarifications and next steps inline: 

- Invoice visibility: yes — we will surface the early-adopter credit as a line-item credit on Month 1 invoice (and, upon request, as a statement of credit applied across first three invoices). I'll include the language in the SOW.
- KMS/HSM & audit logs: KMS integrations (AWS KMS) are supported and included in the platform fee. HSM integration is available as a one-time configuration effort (we typically treat HSM as a professional-services item; estimate: 20-40 hours). Audit logs retention: default 12 months retained in the control plane; we can extend to 24 months for an additional fee — will call this out in the SOW.
- Early conversion: if MedTech moves from pilot to a paid committed deployment prior to the end of the 12-month pilot, credits applied during the pilot remain credited (we do not claw them back). We can also pro-rate any remaining migration credits toward the committed term.

Next steps I will take today: 
1) Share a 2-page pilot SOW that: (a) shows platform fee, (b) lists the 25% Year‑1 early-adopter credit as an invoice line-item, and (c) contains KMS/HSM and audit-log clauses.
2) Add explicit SLA credit table and the Premium support pricing as a schedule.
3) Add a short professional-services estimate for the HSM work and migration hours (100–200 hours depending on complexity).

Can we do a 30-min call Friday 09:00 PT to run through the SOW? If that works I will mark calendar and loop Legal to prepare redlines after your in-call feedback.

Thanks — looping David to confirm invoicing cadence options on Redwood side.

– Soojin
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
